components.name: Primary Action

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Neutral search field with readable placeholder and visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Active navigation uses inverse neutral tones; count stays secondary until selected.
components.css: .ds-sidebar{width:196px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--side,#ebebeb)}.ds-nav{font:14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4d4d4);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out;width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;padding:9px 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#111)}.ds-nav[aria-current=page]{background:var(--text,#111);color:var(--bg,#f4f4f4)}.ds-nav span{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px}.ds-nav:hover{border-color:var(--text,#111)}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#111);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Hot Cue Card
components.description: Musical cue color is data encoding within the neutral workspace.
components.css: .ds-cue{width:230px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4d4d4);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface,#fff)}.ds-cue-trigger{font:14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4d4d4);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#111);width:100%;min-height:60px;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:left;white-space:normal}.ds-cue-slot{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;background:#ef5c86;color:#16201d;font-weight:700}.ds-cue-trigger small{display:block;color:var(--muted,#5e5e5e);margin-top:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-cue-trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#111);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Recommended Source
components.description: Stable duration and action columns; green outline has an accompanying written reason.
components.html: 4:12
components.css: .ds-source{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 42px 100px;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--recommended,#43835a);border-radius:7px;color:var(--text,#111);font:14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-source-title{border:0;background:transparent;min-width:0;padding:3px 0;text-align:left;white-space:normal;line-height:1.45;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-source-title small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#5e5e5e);margin-top:3px}.ds-source-time{font-size:12px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted,#5e5e5e)}.ds-use-source{font:14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4d4d4);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out;min-height:32px;font-size:11px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#111)}.ds-source-title:focus-visible,.ds-use-source:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#111);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-use-source:hover{border-color:var(--text,#111)}

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: Compact chevron disclosure; application content expansion shares the recorded motion tokens.
components.html:
Review sources
Source title, duration and action
components.css: .ds-disclosure{font:12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#5e5e5e)}.ds-disclosure summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px 0;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-disclosure svg{transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-disclosure[open] svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#111);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-disclosure-body{padding:6px 3px 8px 0;color:var(--text,#111)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-disclosure svg{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.overview:
CrateLoom uses the supplied original monochrome brand assets in a compact workspace for preparing local music. System typography, thin dividers and neutral tonal layers keep track information, source provenance and editable cue positions prominent. The light and dark themes have separate palettes.

The interface supports the local, offline work and human review required by `PRODUCT.md`. Status includes text, controls show keyboard focus, and errors should suggest a next action. Native window controls belong to the operating system.

Visual evidence in `.impeccable/review/` comes from browser fixtures; native window behavior remains unverified.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome application chrome with deliberate musical data colors.
Compact rows, stable columns and concise action labels.
Native controls, visible focus and reviewable analysis.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Keep application chrome monochrome. Preserve waveform RGB, hot-cue and musical-section colors because they encode musical information. Source recommendations use a restrained green outline together with a written recommendation and reason.

rules.name: The Track First Rule
rules.body: Keep track names and editable cue positions more prominent than auxiliary metadata. Use short, direct labels and sentence case for actions.

dos: Do use the supplied original CrateLoom mark and application icon.
Do preserve compact native conventions, readable themes and visible keyboard focus.
Do show status text, useful errors and source provenance beside the affected work.
Do keep musical data colors distinct from monochrome interface chrome.
donts: Don't reintroduce teal as an interface accent or add a sidebar wordmark.
Don't replace native window controls with simulated traffic lights.
Don't communicate recommendation, progress or errors through color alone.
Don't present fast section estimates as proprietary semantic analysis or imply an export was imported into rekordbox.
